headline: I build <mark>multimodal generative models</mark>
paragraphs: I sing and play the guitar and drums in a band. Loving music naturally led me to text-to-MIDI research. I believe in the power of steady habits, I enjoy eating, seeing, and listening to good things with good people, and I keep working on communication for better teamwork.
